assumptions.cryptoMapping: BTC benchmark; BTC realised volatility; IEF safe-haven comparator; HYG/LQD US macro credit; daily-rebalanced fixed NONCORE-EW/CORE-EW breadth proxy.
assumptions.cryptoTarget: BTC-USD is the configured Crypto benchmark and the explicit return target; it is not a total-crypto-market index.
assumptions.primarySample: Every market uses only rows with all six configured components (componentCount === 6).
assumptions.timing: Signal on target bar t; enter at close t+1; exit at close t+1+h. Exact signal/target date match required.
assumptions.vintage: Current downloaded histories are not point-in-time vintages; historical revisions and survivorship effects cannot be ruled out.
